scope: Complete surviving1900 Matiu/Somes Island lighthouse, not the relocated1866 tower. Full original native22-vertex outline includes round masonry tower and attached four-corner gabled entrance porch. White cylindrical base/plinth/cornice, broad lantern gallery, sector lantern with blank landward diamond-braced panels and dark seaward glass/white framing, domed metal roof/riveted seam and access loops, vent cowl/finial, external ladder/cage and own entry doors. Exclude keeper cottages, island/shore/sea/vegetation/city, paths/stairs beyond the building, signs/people and interior.

quallaSearch.notes: Qualla-first full source-family inventory. Only exact already-published1944x2592 Matt Lamont2008 original inspected; native SHA1, named own photographer and PD-self grant matched. It shows white cylindrical base, own white gabled porch, broad round gallery, white landward triangular/diamond lantern panels and dark glazing edge, white frames, dark patinated domed roof, metal roof access loops/vent cowl/finial and tall external ladder/cage. Other attribution/media not used; no supplemental photographs/copied pixels/generated bitmap. Primary DOC and harbour operator text only confirm current1900 tower, removal of old tower and continued navigation use; their imagery unused. Native22-vertex base/porch footprint inspected; hidden sections, fine heights and host contact approximate.
